teks_bacaan.speaker_procedure:
How to Use a Portable Bluetooth Speaker

Using a portable Bluetooth speaker is straightforward, but following the correct steps ensures the best sound quality and safety. First, ensure the speaker is fully charged. Plug it into a power source using the provided USB cable until the indicator light turns green or stops blinking. Second, turn on the speaker by pressing and holding the power button for three seconds. You will hear a chime, and a blue light will begin to flash, indicating that the speaker is in pairing mode.

Next, enable the Bluetooth feature on your smartphone or laptop. Scan for available devices and select your speaker's name from the list. Once connected, the flashing blue light will become steady. Before playing any music, it is highly recommended to turn down the volume on both your device and the speaker. This prevents sudden, loud audio blasts that can damage your hearing or the speaker's components. After the music starts, you can gradually adjust the volume to your preferred level using the speaker's volume buttons.

When you are finished, power off the speaker to conserve battery life. Avoid exposing the device to extreme heat or water, as this may cause permanent damage.

Source: Tech Manuals
teks_bacaan.nepal_van_java:
Nepal Van Java: A Culinary and Visual Escape

Located on the slopes of Mount Sumbing in Kaliangkrik, Magelang, Central Java, Nepal Van Java has become a viral tourist destination. The area earned its nickname because the colorful houses perched on the steep, terraced hills resemble the landscapes of Nepal. The cool mountain air and stunning sunrise views attract thousands of visitors every weekend.

However, the true highlight of Nepal Van Java is not just its scenery, but its vibrant culinary scene. The food section is an essential part of the experience. As you walk along the narrow village paths, you will find dozens of small stalls and warungs offering traditional Javanese delicacies. One of the most famous dishes here is Sego Megono, a traditional Central Javanese meal consisting of rice topped with chopped young jackfruit cooked in coconut milk and spices. It is savory, creamy, and perfect for the chilly mountain weather.

For snacks, visitors can enjoy roasted sweet corn slathered in butter, or warm 'Ketan Bubuk' (sticky rice with grated coconut and sugar). To wash it all down, the local hot ginger tea or traditional Javanese coffee is highly recommended. The culinary experience here is authentic and affordable.

Visitors are advised to arrive early in the morning to avoid the crowds and to secure the best spots in the food stalls while enjoying the view. The combination of breathtaking scenery and delicious local food makes Nepal Van Java an unforgettable destination.

Source: Indonesia Travel
teks_bacaan.zebra_camel:
The Zebra and the Camel

Once upon a time, in the vast savannah of Africa, a young zebra was grazing near a waterhole. One day, a camel from the desert wandered into the savannah, looking for water. The zebra looked at the camel and burst into laughter. "What a strange creature you are!" the zebra exclaimed. "You have a huge, ugly bump on your back, and your legs are so long and knobby. How can you possibly survive looking like that?"

The camel, who was drinking water calmly, looked up and smiled. "This 'bump' on my back is called a hump," the camel replied politely. "It stores fat, which allows me to survive for weeks in the desert without food or water. My long legs keep my body far from the hot sand."

The zebra scoffed. "Well, look at my beautiful black and white stripes. They help me blend in with the shadows of the tall grass, and my body is sleek and fast. You must be slow and clumsy."

The camel just nodded. "I am indeed slow, but I have endurance. I can walk for days without resting."

A few days later, a fierce sandstorm blew into the edge of the savannah. The zebra, unable to see through the blinding sand, became terrified. The camel calmly approached the zebra. "Follow me, and close your eyes," said the camel. The camel used its long legs and wide feet to navigate the shifting sands safely, leading the panicked zebra to a sheltered oasis. The camel also used its body to shield the smaller zebra from the stinging sand.

When the storm passed, the zebra felt deeply ashamed. "I am sorry I mocked you," said the zebra. "Your strange features saved my life today." The camel smiled warmly. "We are all built for different environments. What seems strange to you is a necessity for me. We all have our own strengths." From that day on, the zebra never judged another animal by its appearance.

Source: Adapted Fable
teks_bacaan.salar_uyuni:
Salar de Uyuni: The Mirror of the Sky

Salar de Uyuni is the world's largest salt flat, covering over 10,000 square kilometers in southwest Bolivia. It was formed by the transformation of several prehistoric lakes that have long since evaporated, leaving behind a massive crust of salt. The flat is so large and so flat that it is used to calibrate the altimeters of Earth observation satellites.

For most of the year, Salar de Uyuni appears as a vast, blindingly white expanse of polygonal salt crust. It is a surreal and seemingly endless landscape. However, during the rainy season, from December to April, a thin layer of water transforms the salt flat into the world's largest mirror. The sky is reflected perfectly on the ground, creating an optical illusion where the horizon completely disappears. Visitors describe the experience as walking in the clouds.

Tourists from all over the world flock to the salt flat to take perspective-defying photographs, playing with the lack of depth perception. Another popular attraction is Incahuasi Island, a rocky outcropping in the middle of the salt flat covered in giant, centuries-old cacti.

Despite its stunning beauty, the environment is harsh. The high altitude and intense sun require visitors to wear protective gear. The region is also a vital source of lithium, a key component in modern batteries, sparking debates about the balance between industrial extraction and environmental conservation.

Source: National Geographic
teks_bacaan.fire_bowl_procedure:
How to Prepare a Portable Fire Bowl for a Backyard Party

A fire bowl is an excellent way to add warmth and ambiance to an outdoor gathering. Here is a step-by-step guide to safely setting up and using a portable fire bowl.

Materials needed: A heat-resistant metal fire bowl, a bag of silica sand, firewood, charcoal, fire starters, and a long lighter.

1. Choose the Right Location: Place the fire bowl on a flat, level surface. Ensure it is situated at least three meters away from any wooden fences, overhanging tree branches, or flammable garden furniture. Never place it on a wooden deck.

2. Add a Safety Layer of Sand: Pour a layer of silica sand into the bottom of the fire bowl, about two inches thick. This acts as an insulator to protect the metal bowl from extreme heat and helps radiate warmth outward.

3. Arrange the Fuel: Place crumpled newspapers or fire starters in the center of the bowl. Arrange the firewood and charcoal in a pyramid shape over the starters, allowing enough space for oxygen to flow between the logs.

4. Light the Fire: Use a long lighter to ignite the fire starters. Do not lean over the bowl while lighting it.

5. Manage the Fire: Once the fire is burning steadily, you can add more wood if necessary. If you are playing music in the background, make sure to turn down the volume occasionally so you can hear any safety concerns or conversations from your guests. Keep a bucket of water or a fire extinguisher nearby just in case.

6. Extinguishing the Fire: When the party is over, let the fire burn out completely. Do not pour water directly onto a hot metal bowl, as this can cause it to warp or crack. Once cooled, dispose of the ashes safely.

Source: Home & Garden Safety
teks_bacaan.chip_race:
The Great Chip Race

The global semiconductor shortage that emerged between 2020 and 2023 exposed a profound structural vulnerability in modern industrial supply chains. When pandemic-induced factory shutdowns in Taiwan and South Korea coincided with a sudden surge in consumer electronics demand, automakers across Europe and North America found themselves unable to source the chips necessary to complete vehicle production. Ford, General Motors, and Volkswagen collectively lost billions of dollars in potential revenue as partially assembled vehicles sat idle in factory lots.

In response, governments in the United States, European Union, and Japan launched unprecedented industrial policy initiatives. The US CHIPS and Science Act of 2022 allocated $52.7 billion to domestic semiconductor manufacturing, while the EU Chips Act aimed to double Europe's global chip market share to 20% by 2030. These legislative interventions marked a decisive shift away from the free-market orthodoxy that had governed industrial policy for three decades.

Critics, however, caution that state-directed investment in semiconductor manufacturing is not a panacea. Building a cutting-edge semiconductor fabrication plant (fab) requires not only capital (upward of $20 billion per facility) but also a highly specialised workforce, mature supplier ecosystems, and decades of accumulated tacit knowledge. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) did not achieve its dominance overnight. It benefited from a 35-year government-industry collaboration. Simply subsidising new fabs in Western nations, critics argue, cannot replicate that embedded expertise in the near term.

Source: Chip War: The Fight for the World's Most Critical Technology

soal.pertanyaan: According to the text, what is the main reason for turning down the volume before playing music?

To ensure that the Bluetooth connection remains stable and uninterrupted.
To prevent sudden, loud audio blasts that can damage hearing or the speaker.
To avoid disturbing neighbors and maintain a peaceful environment.
To check if the speaker's physical volume buttons are functioning properly.

A blue light begins to flash rapidly.
The speaker emits a loud, continuous chime.
The flashing blue light becomes steady.
The power button automatically turns red.

soal.pertanyaan: Which of the following statements are TRUE according to the text? There is more than one correct answer.
pilihan: The speaker should be fully charged before use to ensure best quality.
You should turn off the speaker to conserve battery life when finished.
Exposing the device to water is safe because it is portable.
The power button must be pressed for exactly ten seconds to turn on.
The volume can be adjusted gradually using the speaker's volume buttons.
soal.pembahasan: A, B, dan E benar. C salah karena teks melarang air. D salah karena teks menyebut tiga detik.

soal.pertanyaan: What is the main purpose of the text?
pilihan: To describe the advanced features of a modern Bluetooth speaker.
To provide step-by-step instructions on how to use a Bluetooth speaker safely.
To explain the process of fixing a Bluetooth speaker that won't charge.
To compare the sound quality of different portable speaker brands.
To persuade readers to purchase a specific model of Bluetooth speaker.

pernyataan: The speaker is in pairing mode when the blue light is flashing.
You should pour water directly onto the speaker if it overheats.
Pressing and holding the power button for three seconds turns the speaker on.
soal.pembahasan: (1) Benar, sesuai paragraf 1. (2) Salah, teks menyebut 'Avoid exposing the device... to water'. (3) Benar, sesuai paragraf 1.

pilihan: Because it is mostly inhabited by immigrants from Nepal.
Because the weather and temperature perfectly mimic the country of Nepal.
Because the colorful houses on steep hills resemble the landscape of Nepal.
Because the local food is heavily influenced by Nepalese cuisine.
Because it is a mandatory destination for Nepalese tourists visiting Indonesia.

soal.pertanyaan: According to the text, which of the following are local culinary specialties found in Nepal Van Java? There is more than one correct answer.
pilihan: Sego Megono (rice with young jackfruit)
Ketan Bubuk (sticky rice with coconut and sugar)
Imported sushi and ramen
Roasted sweet corn with butter
Hot ginger tea

soal.pertanyaan: What does the second paragraph mainly discuss?
pilihan: The geographical history of Mount Sumbing.
The vibrant culinary experience and local food offered.
The best spots to take sunrise photographs.
The affordable prices of accommodations in Magelang.
The traditional farming methods used by the villagers.
soal.pembahasan: Paragraf 2 secara eksplisit membahas 'the true highlight of Nepal Van Java is not just its scenery, but its vibrant culinary scene'.

soal.pertanyaan: What are visitors advised to do regarding the food stalls and the crowds?
pilihan: Bring their own food because the local stalls are expensive.
Arrive early in the morning to secure the best spots and avoid crowds.
Visit only during the rainy season to get a better view from the stalls.
Eat at the bottom of the hill before hiking up to the village.
Avoid the local coffee because it is too bitter for most tourists.

Sego Megono is a traditional dish made from young jackfruit cooked in coconut milk.
Visitors are advised to visit at noon to avoid the morning fog.
The culinary experience at Nepal Van Java is described as expensive and modern.

soal.pertanyaan: What was the primary reason the zebra mocked the camel upon their first meeting?
pilihan: The zebra thought the camel's physical features were strange and useless.
The zebra was angry because the camel drank all the water from the hole.
The zebra wanted to prove that it could run faster than the camel.
The zebra was jealous of the camel's ability to survive in the desert.
The zebra mistakenly thought the camel was a predator from the savannah.
soal.pembahasan: Paragraf 1 menyebutkan zebra tertawa dan berkata 'What a strange creature you are! ... You have a huge, ugly bump on your back, and your legs are so long and knobby.'

soal.pertanyaan: According to the camel, what is the biological function of the hump on its back?
pilihan: To store water that can be used during the rainy season.
To store fat, allowing it to survive without food or water for weeks.
To help it blend in with the sand dunes when hiding from predators.
To make the camel look taller and more intimidating to enemies.
To help the camel float when crossing a deep river.
soal.pembahasan: Paragraf 2 menyebutkan: 'It stores fat, which allows me to survive for weeks in the desert without food or water.'

soal.pertanyaan: What lessons can be learned from the story? There is more than one correct answer.
pilihan: We should not judge others based on their physical appearance.
Different animals have unique physical features suited for their environments.
Zebras are naturally evil and cannot be trusted in the savannah.
Understanding and appreciating each other's strengths is valuable.
Camels are completely useless when they leave the desert.
soal.pembahasan: A, B, dan D sesuai dengan pesan moral cerita. C dan E bertentangan dengan isi teks.

soal.pertanyaan: How did the camel prove its physical advantages during the sandstorm?
pilihan: It ran faster than the zebra to find shelter in the savannah.
It used its body to shield the zebra and navigated safely with its wide feet.
It carried the zebra on its hump to protect it from the sand.
It dug a deep hole in the ground for both of them to hide in.
It fought off predators that were attacking them in the storm.
soal.pembahasan: Paragraf 5 menyebutkan: 'The camel used its long legs and wide feet to navigate... The camel also used its body to shield the smaller zebra from the stinging sand.'

soal.pertanyaan: Determine whether each statement is TRUE or FALSE based on the story!
pernyataan: The zebra has black and white stripes that help it blend into the shadows.
The camel mocked the zebra back when they first met.
The zebra realized its mistake and apologized after the sandstorm.
The camel was born and raised in the savannah.
soal.pembahasan: (1) Benar. (2) Salah, camel menjawab dengan sopan. (3) Benar ('I am sorry I mocked you'). (4) Salah, camel berasal dari gurun (desert).

soal.pertanyaan: What phenomenon transforms Salar de Uyuni into the world's largest mirror?
pilihan: The complete evaporation of the salt crust during the summer.
A thin layer of water covering the flat during the rainy season.
The blooming of thousands of giant cacti on the island.
The reflection of the sun on the white polygonal salt crust.
The freezing of the water surface into a giant ice rink.
soal.pembahasan: Paragraf 2 menyebutkan: 'during the rainy season... a thin layer of water transforms the salt flat into the world's largest mirror.'

soal.pertanyaan: Based on the text, which of the following are typical activities for tourists at Salar de Uyuni? There is more than one correct answer.
pilihan: Taking perspective-defying photographs.
Visiting Incahuasi Island to see giant cacti.
Swimming in the deep water of the salt flat.
Calibrating the altimeters of Earth observation satellites.
Experiencing the illusion of walking in the clouds.
soal.pembahasan: A, B, dan E adalah kegiatan turis (paragraf 2 & 3). C salah (airnya tipis). D adalah fungsi ilmiah satelit, bukan kegiatan turis.

soal.pertanyaan: What is the main focus of the third paragraph?
pilihan: The environmental damage caused by lithium extraction.
The most popular tourist activities and attractions at the salt flat.
The history of how the prehistoric lakes evaporated.
The scientific importance of the salt flat for space agencies.
The dangerous wildlife that lives around the cacti.
soal.pembahasan: Paragraf 3 membahas tentang apa yang dilakukan turis di sana: 'Tourists... flock... to take perspective-defying photographs. Another popular attraction is Incahuasi Island...'

soal.pertanyaan: In the second paragraph, the word "surreal" is closest in meaning to...
pilihan: Extremely dangerous and life-threatening for visitors.
Bizarre, dreamlike, and seemingly unreal.
Extremely hot and physically uncomfortable.
Ordinary, common, and easily found elsewhere.
Loud, chaotic, and crowded with tourists.

soal.pertanyaan: Determine whether each statement is TRUE or FALSE based on the passage!
pernyataan: The flat is so flat that it is used to calibrate satellite altimeters.
The mirror effect of the sky reflection happens throughout the entire year.
The region is a vital source of lithium for modern batteries.
Visitors do not need protective gear because the weather is very mild.

pilihan: To help the firewood catch fire more quickly and burn brighter.
To act as an insulator, protecting the metal bowl from extreme heat.
To create a pleasant aroma when the fire begins to burn.
To prevent insects and pests from entering the fire bowl.
To reduce the amount of charcoal needed to maintain the fire.

pilihan: On a flat, level surface.
On a wooden deck.
At least three meters away from trees.
In a spacious backyard.

pilihan: Pour a bucket of water immediately onto the hot metal bowl.

pernyataan: You should arrange the firewood in a flat, single layer to make it easier to light.
Pouring water directly onto a hot metal bowl can cause it to warp or crack.
You are advised to turn down the music volume to hear safety concerns.
soal.pembahasan: (1) Salah, langkah 3 menyebut 'pyramid shape'. (2) Benar, sesuai langkah 6. (3) Benar, sesuai langkah 5.

soal.pertanyaan: Based on Paragraph 1, what can be reasonably inferred about the global automotive supply chain before the chip shortage occurred?
pilihan: It operated with very limited buffer capacity, leaving automakers highly exposed.
It had already begun diversifying away from Asian semiconductor suppliers.
It was structured primarily around domestic semiconductor production in Europe.
It had anticipated the surge in consumer electronics demand and prepared accordingly.
It relied entirely on continuous government subsidies to stay stable.
soal.pembahasan: Penutupan pabrik bertepatan dengan lonjakan permintaan membuat produsen mobil tidak bisa mendapatkan chip. Ini menyiratkan tidak adanya cadangan (buffer capacity) saat permintaan bergeser.

soal.pertanyaan: Why did the author choose to cite specific figures such as $52.7 billion and $20 billion in the text? There is more than one correct answer.
pilihan: To ground the discussion in concrete terms regarding the scale of the government response.
To prove that government subsidies will definitely solve the supply chain issue.
To illustrate the immense financial cost required to build just one fabrication plant.
To compare the semiconductor industry spending against military defence budgets.
To distract readers from the central argument concerning workforce expertise.
soal.pembahasan: A dan C benar. Angka $52.7B menunjukkan skala respons pemerintah, dan $20B menunjukkan besarnya biaya membangun pabrik (fab). B terlalu absolut, D dan E tidak didukung teks.

soal.pertanyaan: In the context of Paragraph 3, the word 'panacea' is closest in meaning to...
pilihan: A temporary measure intended to delay a problem rather than resolve it.
A costly investment that produces no measurable economic benefit.
A policy approach rejected by the majority of economic experts.
A universal solution capable of resolving every aspect of a complex problem.
A strategy implemented without sufficient long-term planning.
soal.pembahasan: Kalimat 'is not a panacea' berarti investasi tersebut bukanlah obat mujarab atau solusi universal untuk semua masalah.

soal.pertanyaan: Which option best describes the author's tone in presenting the criticisms discussed in Paragraph 3?
pilihan: Alarmist, implying that government intervention has already failed beyond repair.
Sarcastic, mocking policymakers for assuming that industrial policy could ever succeed.
Indifferent, treating the criticism as a minor footnote with little bearing.
Measured and analytical, raising reasoned skepticism without dismissing intervention.
Hostile, openly condemning government spending on semiconductors as wasteful.
soal.pembahasan: Penulis menggunakan kata 'however, caution' dan memaparkan fakta (TSMC butuh 35 tahun). Nada penulis terukur (measured) dan analitis.

soal.pertanyaan: Determine whether each statement is TRUE or FALSE based on the passage!
pernyataan: Automakers lost billions of dollars because partially assembled vehicles sat idle.
TSMC achieved its dominance in the semiconductor industry overnight.
Building a cutting-edge semiconductor fabrication plant costs upward of $20 billion.
The EU Chips Act aims to double Europe's global chip market share by 2030.
soal.pembahasan: (1) Benar (paragraf 1). (2) Salah, butuh 35 tahun kolaborasi. (3) Benar (paragraf 3). (4) Benar (paragraf 2).
